verdict.rationale: Anrok runs several tax jobs in the background: filing and payments are 'done for you', registrations complete automatically, nexus alerts fire before you owe, and the Stripe integration keeps managing tax on later billing cycles. Headless Tax also says tax can be 'handed to your agents'. These are vendor-managed automations, though, and nothing shows users can define their own background workflows, triggers or schedules. missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, user-defined triggers or schedules, documentation of how agent hand-off runs autonomously, independent hands-on corroboration.
